recommendations.recommendation: Repeat and remember the name of Rama.
recommendations.rationale: In the Kali age the name is the only refuge; it is greater even than Rama himself and carries devotees across the ocean of existence.
rationale_type: authority of a person or tradition
recommendations.scope: all people in the Kali age

recommendations.recommendation: Cultivate loving devotion to Rama as the highest and easiest path.
recommendations.rationale: Knowledge is hard and slippery, while devotion is easy, independent, and dear to Rama; without devotion nothing else avails.

recommendations.recommendation: Practice the 9 forms of devotion that Rama taught Shabari.
recommendations.rationale: Rama declares that anyone with even 1 of these forms of devotion is dearest to him, whatever their caste or sex.
recommendations.scope: all people, regardless of birth or gender

recommendations.rationale: Without the company of the holy there is no discernment, and such company is gained only by Rama's grace; it is the root of joy.

recommendations.recommendation: Avoid the company of the wicked.
recommendations.rationale: The wicked rejoice in others' harm and grieve at their good; their company corrupts.

recommendations.recommendation: Regard helping others as the highest duty and harming others as the gravest sin.
recommendations.rationale: There is no duty equal to doing good to others and no wrong equal to causing them pain, as the Vedas and Puranas affirm.

recommendations.recommendation: Keep your word even at the cost of your life.
recommendations.rationale: It is the tradition of the Raghu line that life may go but a promise must not; Dasharatha died honoring his vow.
rationale_type: authority of a person or tradition

recommendations.recommendation: Obey your parents' command willingly, as Rama accepted exile.
recommendations.rationale: A son who obeys his father and mother is blessed; Rama gladly went to the forest to uphold his father's word.
rationale_type: authority of a person or tradition

recommendations.recommendation: Be devoted to your husband in thought, word, and deed.
recommendations.rationale: Anasuya teaches Sita that devotion to the husband is a wife's one duty and path to the highest state; Sita models it.
rationale_type: authority of a person or tradition

recommendations.recommendation: Love and serve your brothers selflessly, as Lakshmana and Bharata did.
recommendations.rationale: Bharata refused the throne and ruled only as Rama's servant; such brotherly love is exalted as ideal.
rationale_type: authority of a person or tradition
recommendations.argued_against: Kaikeyi's scheming for her son's gain

recommendations.recommendation: As a ruler, govern for the welfare of your subjects.
recommendations.rationale: A king under whom dear subjects suffer deserves hell; Rama's reign brought peace, health, and righteousness to all.
rationale_type: authority of a person or tradition
recommendations.argued_against: kings who make their subjects suffer

recommendations.recommendation: Conquer lust, anger, greed, and pride.
recommendations.rationale: These passions, rooted in delusion, are the paths to hell and the diseases of the mind.

recommendations.recommendation: Take refuge in Rama, who protects even sinners who come to him.
recommendations.rationale: Rama vowed never to forsake one who seeks shelter, as with Vibhishana; abandoning a refugee is a grave sin.
recommendations.argued_against: those who reject a person seeking refuge

recommendations.recommendation: Honor Shiva and Rama together rather than favoring one and despising the other.
recommendations.rationale: Rama declares that one who worships Shiva yet opposes Rama, or the reverse, cannot attain him.
recommendations.argued_against: sectarian hostility between Shaivas and Vaishnavas

recommendations.recommendation: Revere your guru and begin every undertaking by honoring guru and gods.
recommendations.rationale: The dust of the guru's feet purifies the mind's mirror so that Rama's story can be seen clearly.
rationale_type: authority of a person or tradition

recommendations.recommendation: Be a true friend: share your friend's sorrow, turn him from wrong, and help him in trouble.
recommendations.rationale: Rama tells Sugriva that one who is unmoved by a friend's grief is a sinner; true friends conceal faults and proclaim virtues.
recommendations.argued_against: false friends who flatter to the face and harm behind the back

recommendations.recommendation: Remain humble and free of conceit.
recommendations.rationale: The poet himself writes in humility, and pride brings downfall, as the arrogant Ravana shows.
rationale_type: authority of a person or tradition

recommendations.rationale: Rama incarnated to protect them, and serving them pleases him.
recommendations.argued_against: those who insult Brahmins and saints

recommendations.recommendation: Hear, recite, and sing the story of Rama.
recommendations.rationale: The tale purifies the mind, removes the sins of the Kali age, and grants devotion to Rama.
